# pve_sdn_prefix_list (Resource)

FRR prefix list used by BGP/EVPN route filtering.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pve_sdn_prefix_list" "example" {
  item_id = "CHANGE_ME"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `item_id` (String) The SDN prefix list identifier

### Optional

- `delete` (List of String) <array>
- `entries` (List of String) <array>
- `lock_token` (String) the token for unlocking the global SDN configuration

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Opaque identifier: item_id (also the `terraform import` format).
